title: Gandhada Gudi
desc: When forest officer Kumar protects natural resources from poachers, their boss, Anand, becomes his main rival. But little does Kumar know that Anand is his brother.

title: Ee Jeeva Ninagagi
desc: Chandrashekhar and Rohini share a deep love and devotion for each other. However, their relationship faces challenges when Rohini discovers that Chandrashekhar is caring for his sister's child.

title: Suprabhatha
desc: Vijay takes in Hema, who pretends to be speech-impaired but hides a dark past, along with her brother, Sundareshwar. As secrets unfold, Vijay discovers the shocking truth.

title: Jeevanadhi
desc: After several years of marriage, a couple becomes parents. However, after a childless couple finds their infant boy, they take him away and try to raise him as their own son.

title: Varsha
desc: After his mother's death and father's arrest, Sathya brings up his seven sisters like a father. But a villainous character from his father's past turns the siblings against each other.
